The good-edge overlap graph is Eulerian, and a strict count \(P_n>W_{n-1}\) proves the exact pairwise gap. With the metric normalization \(r^s=1/\lambda\), the upper and lower bounds converge to lambda uniformly over diverging periods. Direct adjacency-matrix spectral decomposition proves exact cylinder statistics, rate and nonvanishing leading sign. The executable stdlib verifier was run on \(q\in\{2,3,4\}\) and \(2\le n\le6\); its finite tests support but do not establish the universal theorem.

value.rationale: Periodic content is a motivated invariant from the 2026 source, but the exact critical value is not supplied by entropy or the periodic dimension. The star SFT is a canonical first non-full-shift model with a nontrivial obstruction: noncyclically admissible windows occur within cyclic admissible words. A structural cut balance controls them sharply, yielding the exact critical metric constant lambda for all q and r. The same extremal Euler words possess explicit Parry-cylinder frequencies with a sharp alternating spectral correction; neither a generic existence theorem nor a table gives this complete dynamical description.
